instruction: My roommate asked me to return something I had ordered for them and venmo them the money for it. Check my messages for details and do as per their instruction.
notes: Three apps (phone, amazon, venmo) plus supervisor. The roommate is identified via phone.search_contacts(relationship="roommate"), which yields both their phone number (to pull the text message with the return instructions) and their email (venmo receiver). The message names the product; amazon.show_orders(query) locates the order, amazon.show_order reveals product id, quantity and cost, show_return_deliverers supplies a deliverer id, and initiate_return creates the ProductReturn. The venmo transaction must go to the roommate for exactly the order cost; the planner cannot verify numeric values so cost is a discrete amount object tied to the order by a static fact and discovered by show_order. Side-effect model changes in the evaluation (file_system, gmail, venmo.Notification) are automatic consequences of initiate_return/create_transaction and are not modeled. No answer is required, so supervisor-complete-task takes only task-record parameters and is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every other action.
